text.text_excerpt: Mermaids is a new restaurant in New Orleans East. It's a welcome new addition they have 10 50inch tvs and 1 giant projection screen on the wall. It was a perfect spot to catch the game and they had lots of food options along with a full service bar. I kept it simple while watching the game & had the Classic Cheeseburger w Cajun seasoned fries. The patty was big & juicy. I literally thought they forgot the bottom Bun but it was hidden under the beef Patty. The meat was seasoned and cooked perfectly & a good portion of fries for $9. I recently went here to pick up some food to go. As a resident of New Orleans East I love to support the area when I can. I've been wanting to try this place for a while base on a recommendation I received. The restaurant is a very nice size but due to Covid it's limited seating. Since I wanted to get my food to go this was fine by me. They have a pretty nice size menu so after much deliberation I decided to get the Bayou Pasta (creamy shrimp pasta, topped with fried catfish, a side of vegetables and a roll) all of that food for only $14.99. The food was very good. They also have some cute signatures cocktails that I would love to try when I go back with friends. Located in a strip mall s...

I recently discovered Mermaids on a food delivery app and I was extremely impressed! We ordered seafood fries for the appetizer and the catfish platter and bayou pasta. Everything arrived piping hot and the fries weren't even soggy! Everything tasted amazing and 10/10 would recommend! This is also a black owned business so it's important to keep supporting and it's awesome that businesses are making their way back into New Orleans East again!
